question: **Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 4.**
solution:
The correct answer is: Imagined.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Let's look at the meaning of the given words.

 
 
• Aimed: To have the intention of achieving something. (उद्देश्य)
 
• Opposed: To disagree with a principle or plan. (विपक्षी)
 
• Arranged: To put things in a neat, attractive, or required order. (व्यवस्था)
 
• Imagined: Something unreal or untrue believed to exist or be so. (कल्पना)
 
 
 
• So, as per the meaning of the given words "imagined" is the most appropriate option.
 
• Therefore, the correct answer is option 4.

 

Complete passage: *Everything we know about non-avian dinosaurs is based on (1)__ fossils, which include bones, teeth, footprints, tracks, eggs, and skin impressions. For centuries, people throughout the world have __discovered (2)__ amazing fossilized bones and footprints. Early finds inspired __legends (3)__ and fairy tales, and people **__imagined (4)__** that these bones belonged to________ (5) or huge monsters.*
